description: This file defines a ResNet backbone class and functions to construct RetinaNet models with ResNet backbones, including utilities for downloading ImageNet weights and validating backbone types.

classes.name: ResNetBackbone
classes.description: A class representing a ResNet backbone for object detection, providing methods for model creation, weight downloading, validation, and image preprocessing.

methods.name: resnet_retinanet
methods.description: Constructs a RetinaNet model using a specified ResNet backbone, allowing customization of inputs and backbone modification.

methods.name: resnet50_retinanet
methods.description: Convenience function to create a RetinaNet with a ResNet-50 backbone.

methods.name: resnet101_retinanet
methods.description: Convenience function to create a RetinaNet with a ResNet-101 backbone.

methods.name: resnet152_retinanet
methods.description: Convenience function to create a RetinaNet with a ResNet-152 backbone.
